jpg-to-pdf.title: JPG to PDF Converter — JPG, JPEG & PNG | PDFPilot
jpg-to-pdf.description: Convert JPG, JPEG and PNG images to PDF in your browser. Arrange images, choose page size and margins, then download your PDF without a document upload.

word-to-pdf.title: Word to PDF — Convert DOCX Online Free | PDFPilot
word-to-pdf.description: Convert DOCX files to PDF in your browser, including supported images, tables and links. Review the image-based pages before downloading. Legacy DOC is not supported.

powerpoint-to-pdf.title: PowerPoint to PDF — Convert PPTX Free | PDFPilot
powerpoint-to-pdf.description: Convert PPTX presentations to PDF in your browser. Preserve supported slide artwork and dimensions, then check fonts and layout. Legacy PPT is not supported.

excel-to-pdf.title: Excel to PDF — Convert XLSX Workbooks | PDFPilot
excel-to-pdf.description: Convert XLSX sheets to PDF with saved print layouts, supported pictures and charts. Select sheets and check page breaks. Local files stay in your browser.

html-to-pdf.title: HTML to PDF — Files, Markup & Web URLs | PDFPilot
html-to-pdf.description: Create a PDF from HTML files, pasted markup or a public web URL. URL imports and external assets use server requests. Check the rendered result before sharing.

pdf-to-jpg.title: PDF to JPG — Convert Pages or Extract Images | PDFPilot
pdf-to-jpg.description: Turn PDF pages into JPG images or extract supported embedded images. Choose your pages, preview the result and download in your browser without uploading the PDF.

pdf-to-word.title: PDF to Word — Editable DOCX with English OCR | PDFPilot
pdf-to-word.description: Convert selectable PDF text or English scans into editable DOCX. Processing runs in your browser. Review text and formatting; exact page layout is not preserved.

pdf-to-powerpoint.title: PDF to PowerPoint — PDF Pages to PPTX | PDFPilot
pdf-to-powerpoint.description: Convert PDF pages into PowerPoint slides in your browser. Page images preserve appearance; optional extracted text does not recreate original editable slide objects.

pdf-to-excel.title: PDF to Excel — Extract Tables to XLSX | PDFPilot
pdf-to-excel.description: Extract supported PDF tables into an Excel workbook in your browser. Check rows, columns, dates and numbers against the source. Original formulas are not recovered.

pdf-to-pdfa.title: PDF/A Metadata Copy — Review & Validate | PDFPilot
pdf-to-pdfa.description: Create a PDF copy with PDF/A identification metadata in your browser. Choose preservation options and validate the output separately; conformance is not certified.

merge-pdf.title: Merge PDF — Combine Files in Your Chosen Order | PDFPilot
merge-pdf.description: Merge PDF files into one document in your browser. Arrange the files, combine their pages and download the result. Check forms and bookmarks before sharing.

split-pdf.title: Split PDF — Separate Pages and Ranges | PDFPilot
split-pdf.description: Split a PDF into separate documents by pages or ranges. Process files in your browser and check each download. Size splitting does not guarantee exact file sizes.

delete-pages.title: Delete PDF Pages — Remove Selected Pages | PDFPilot
delete-pages.description: Remove unwanted pages from a PDF in your browser. Review the selection, keep at least one page and download an updated copy without uploading your document.

extract-pages.title: Extract PDF Pages — Save Selected Pages | PDFPilot
extract-pages.description: Save selected PDF pages or page ranges as a new document. Check the selection order and download a copy processed in your browser without a document upload.

organize-pdf.title: Organize PDF — Reorder, Add & Remove Pages | PDFPilot
organize-pdf.description: Organize PDF pages in your browser. Reorder, add or remove pages and save a new copy. Review page order and document features before using the download.

rotate-pdf.title: Rotate PDF Pages — Change Page Orientation | PDFPilot
rotate-pdf.description: Rotate selected PDF pages and download a new copy in your browser. Change page orientation without uploading the PDF; perspective correction is not included.

compress-pdf.title: Compress PDF — Reduce File Size Online | PDFPilot
compress-pdf.description: Reduce PDF file size with browser-based compression. Choose a quality level and compare the result. Exact KB targets are not guaranteed; inspect text and links.

repair-pdf.title: Repair PDF — Try to Recover Damaged Files | PDFPilot
repair-pdf.description: Try to repair a damaged PDF in your browser and inspect the recovered pages. Recovery is best effort; this tool cannot restore a file deleted from your device.

ocr-pdf.title: OCR PDF — Recognize English Scanned Text | PDFPilot
ocr-pdf.description: Recognize English text in scanned PDFs with browser-based OCR. Keep the tab open and check the result. Recognition quality depends on the scan and worker support.

scan-pdf.title: Images to Scanned PDF — Import JPG or PNG | PDFPilot
scan-pdf.description: Create a PDF from saved JPG or PNG document images in your browser. Import your images and review the result. Camera capture is currently unavailable.

add-page-numbers.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF Online Free | PDFPilot
add-page-numbers.description: Add page-number labels to a PDF in your browser. Choose the position and starting number, then inspect the result. Existing printed page numbers remain unchanged.

watermark-pdf.title: Watermark PDF — Add Text or Image Marks | PDFPilot
watermark-pdf.description: Add a visible text or image watermark to a PDF in your browser. Review placement before downloading. A watermark does not encrypt files or prevent copying.

crop-pdf.title: Crop PDF Pages — Adjust Visible Margins | PDFPilot
crop-pdf.description: Adjust the visible boundaries of PDF pages in your browser and download a copy. Cropping hides areas from view; it is not secure removal of sensitive content.

edit-pdf.title: Edit PDF Online — Text, Images & Annotations | PDFPilot
edit-pdf.description: Edit supported PDF text, add images and annotate pages in your browser. Save a copy and check fonts and layout. Complex text and scanned pages have limitations.

fill-pdf.title: Fill PDF Forms — Complete Existing Fields | PDFPilot
fill-pdf.description: Fill supported fields in an existing PDF form in your browser. Review the completed values and download a copy. Some field types and document structures differ.

excel-to-xml.title: Excel to XML — Export Spreadsheet Data | PDFPilot
excel-to-xml.description: Convert local Excel workbooks to XML in a browser worker. Select sheets and review the exported structure. Importing a workbook by URL uses a server fetch.
